RetroEnv-RL

LiteFold/RetroEnv

Plan multistep retrosynthesis routes for a target molecule with tools, submitting synthesis trees whose leaves are all in a frozen stock.

Reward

How it is scored
Programmatic check
Signal

A deterministic verifier judges each step against a frozen reaction library, with a similarity bonus for known routes.

How to run it

1. Get the filesthe whole repository, to a local folder

hf download LiteFold/RetroEnv --repo-type dataset --local-dir RetroEnv
